# MCP tool reference

The 51 tools the server offers, read from a running server.

The local service offers the same operations through its CLI and over stdio.

This server identifies itself as `events`. Read each tool's input schema before calling it.

## Tools

| Tool | What it does |
|---|---|
| [`events_status`](#events_status) | Reports whether the local event service has an owner. |
| [`events_stop`](#events_stop) | Requests a clean stop from the local owner. |
| [`events_pause`](#events_pause) | Pauses polling, evaluation and delivery claims without purging state. |
| [`events_resume`](#events_resume) | Resumes work retained by an operational pause. |
| [`events_disable_all`](#events_disable_all) | Disables collection, advances the global generation and purges B1 work. |
| [`events_enable_all`](#events_enable_all) | Reports that a standing disclosure approval is required before enablement. |
| [`events_doctor`](#events_doctor) | Reports content-free lineage, retry, recovery, judge authority, hold-clock and protocol health. |
| [`events_catalogue_list`](#events_catalogue_list) | Lists selectable local event definitions. |
| [`events_approval_view`](#events_approval_view) | Returns the daemon-authoritative preview and fresh challenge without claiming it. |
| [`events_rule_test`](#events_rule_test) | Locally evaluates one selectable catalogue example without provider or judge I/O. |
| [`events_target_test`](#events_target_test) | Sends the fixed synthetic event only to one exact active target version. |
| [`events_subscribers_list`](#events_subscribers_list) | Lists immutable subscriber metadata. |
| [`events_subscriber_add`](#events_subscriber_add) | Creates one immutable subscriber version. |
| [`events_subscriber_update`](#events_subscriber_update) | Creates one replacement immutable subscriber version. |
| [`events_subscriber_remove`](#events_subscriber_remove) | Revokes every live version of one subscriber and closes its streams. |
| [`events_judges_list`](#events_judges_list) | Lists content-free immutable judge metadata. |
| [`events_judge_add`](#events_judge_add) | Creates an immutable, initially inactive judge version. |
| [`events_judge_update`](#events_judge_update) | Creates an immutable replacement judge version. |
| [`events_judge_remove`](#events_judge_remove) | Removes every live immutable version of one judge. |
| [`events_judge_test`](#events_judge_test) | Tests one active exact judge version with the daemon-fixed synthetic event. |
| [`events_budget_show`](#events_budget_show) | Lists immutable judge budgets and the active singleton. |
| [`events_budget_update`](#events_budget_update) | Creates a pending immutable global budget and prepares its approval. |
| [`events_judge_kinds_list`](#events_judge_kinds_list) | Lists each judge kind as disabled or enabled, or Laya as unavailable here with its reason. |
| [`events_judge_kind_enable`](#events_judge_kind_enable) | Prepares, but never approves or claims, judge-kind enablement. |
| [`events_judge_kind_disable`](#events_judge_kind_disable) | Immediately disables one judge kind; for Laya it also cancels a download and keeps verified files. |
| [`events_judge_model_status`](#events_judge_model_status) | Reports the local Laya runtime and model state, byte progress and any failure or unavailable reason. |
| [`events_judge_model_remove`](#events_judge_model_remove) | Deletes the verified Laya model and runtime files, only while Laya is disabled. |
| [`events_deliveries_list`](#events_deliveries_list) | Lists content-free delivery metadata. |
| [`events_delivery_retry`](#events_delivery_retry) | Retries one exact retryable delivery. |
| [`events_delivery_drop`](#events_delivery_drop) | Drops one exact dead-letter delivery and its retained payload. |
| [`events_held_list`](#events_held_list) | Lists content-free held-decision metadata; only a terminal/app may resolve one. |
| [`events_catalogue_show`](#events_catalogue_show) | Shows one selectable local event definition. |
| [`events_sources_list`](#events_sources_list) | Lists configured local event sources. |
| [`events_source_show`](#events_source_show) | Shows one configured local event source. |
| [`events_rules_list`](#events_rules_list) | Lists immutable local event rule versions. |
| [`events_rule_show`](#events_rule_show) | Shows immutable versions of one event rule. |
| [`events_rule_create`](#events_rule_create) | Creates an inert immutable event rule version. |
| [`events_rule_update`](#events_rule_update) | Creates another inert immutable event rule version. |
| [`events_rule_enable`](#events_rule_enable) | Prepares the standing disclosure for a rule version. |
| [`events_rule_disable`](#events_rule_disable) | Immediately disables the active event rule. |
| [`events_rule_remove`](#events_rule_remove) | Immediately removes the active event rule. |
| [`events_targets_list`](#events_targets_list) | Lists immutable local event target versions. |
| [`events_target_add`](#events_target_add) | Creates an inert immutable dry-run target. |
| [`events_target_update`](#events_target_update) | Creates another inert immutable dry-run target version. |
| [`events_target_remove`](#events_target_remove) | Revokes every live version of a dry-run target. |
| [`events_queue_items`](#events_queue_items) | Lists the action queue's items without what they say: id, rule, channel, account, state and times. |
| [`events_queue_counts`](#events_queue_counts) | Counts open, done and dismissed queue items, and each rule’s open items. |
| [`events_queue_done`](#events_queue_done) | Marks one queue item done; it stays for its retention. |
| [`events_queue_dismiss`](#events_queue_dismiss) | Dismisses one queue item; it stays for its retention. |
| [`events_queue_reopen`](#events_queue_reopen) | Reopens one done or dismissed queue item. |
| [`events_queue_clear`](#events_queue_clear) | Removes every done and dismissed queue item now; open items stay. |

### `events_status`

Reports whether the local event service has an owner.

*read-only · idempotent*

Takes no arguments.

### `events_stop`

Requests a clean stop from the local owner.

*writes · destructive · idempotent*

Takes no arguments.

### `events_pause`

### `events_queue_items`

Lists the action queue's items without what they say: id, rule, channel, account, state and times.

*read-only · idempotent*

| Argument | Type | Required | What it is |
|---|---|---|---|
| `state` | `open` \\| `done` \\| `dismissed` \\| `all` | no | Which items: open (the default) or all. |
| `rule` | string | no | Only this rule's items, by rule id. |
| `channel` | `gmail` \\| `slack` \\| `resend` \\| `whatsapp` | no | Only this channel's items. |
| `limit` | integer | no | At most this many items, newest first (default 50). |

### `events_queue_counts`

Counts open, done and dismissed queue items, and each rule’s open items.

*read-only · idempotent*

Takes no arguments.

### `events_queue_done`

Marks one queue item done; it stays for its retention.

*writes · idempotent*

| Argument | Type | Required | What it is |
|---|---|---|---|
| `itemId` | string | **yes** | The item, as events_queue_items gives it: qi_ and 26 Crockford base32 characters. |
